scope: Exact public embedding-row RMS interval and pair-preserving RoPE bounds.

embedding.note: Exact BF16→FP32 stored values squared/summed in rational arithmetic. Configured binary64 epsilon defines the primary interval. Alternate binary32 epsilon is isolated; native pow/mean/add rounding and implementation order are not certified.

score_bound_proof: For exact native RMS with positive epsilon, pre-gamma head norm≤sqrt128. Half-split RoPE preserves each coordinate pair(i,i+64). The norm of diag(gamma_q) Rq.T Rk diag(gamma_k) is at most the largest pairwise product of gamma maxima; same-position rotations cancel exactly. Multiply by128/sqrt128. The rational endpoint encloses sqrt128 outward.
limitations: Public weights only; no prompt/token sequence, model forward or coefficient selection.
The row interval tightens only the first embedding normalization, not later residual or head-projection sites.
Exact-native bounds exclude floating point and CKKS/refresh error; exact orthogonal RoPE is assumed.
The conditional approximate score bound needs uniform relative error at both Q/K norms and the same feature/variance relation; it is not an approximate-graph certificate.
Same-position gamma-product bounds cannot be used for different-position Q/K pairs.
No weights, raw rows, hidden values, keys or ciphertexts are published; exact public aggregate extrema/selected rational sums and tensor hashes are recorded.
